scope: four unchanged low props forming two functional groups in the west docks workyard

latest_default_field_image.credit: east default-camera reference only; west workyard is outside this image

visual_review_of_sources.wood_handcart: Viewed actual pixels: complete two-wheel double-shaft cart in a diagonal 3/4 view, detailed warm weathered wood and iron rims. Suitable only as one static loading obstacle; do not rotate, mirror or imply pushable gameplay.
visual_review_of_sources.grain_sack_stack: Viewed actual pixels: five tied burlap sacks on one low pallet, front-facing and materially distinct from crates. Treat pallet and all sacks as one obstacle.
visual_review_of_sources.style_control: Both sources are warmer and more studio-lit than the cold grey quay; exact scales below reduce them to NPC-readable props. No tint, relighting, alpha cleanup or source edit is authorized. Actual Field image decides final fit.

functional_groups.purpose: stored grain awaiting tally beside the warehouse approach, while leaving the real warehouse door and mud clue legible
functional_groups.spatial_read: The sacks sit on the west side of the warehouse approach; the single crate punctuates the east edge toward the freight spine. They frame storage rather than form a barricade.

functional_groups.purpose: cart staged below the rope shop with one outbound crate near the freight spine
functional_groups.spatial_read: The cart occupies the building-free south yard; the crate sits to its east as the handoff point to the north-south freight road. The open strip between them remains visibly traversable.

cart reads as staged below the shop, never across its frontage or the market connector
